title: Cone 10 Reduction Firing Workshop at Snowfarm
commitment: Fri load · Sat fire · Mon unload
summary: Three-day hands-on workshop with Tyler Gulden covering cone 10 reduction glazing and firing. Participants load and fire a downdraft kiln, work in the studio while it fires, and unload on the final day. Open to experienced beginners and potters wanting to expand glaze options.
source_quote:
Workshop: Cone 10 Reduction Firing @ Snowfarm
May 29-31, 2021
evidence_sentence: The workshops page lists a May 2021 cone 10 reduction firing workshop at Snowfarm led by Tyler Gulden.
evidence_quote: As a group, the class will load and fire a down-draft kiln, learning the important key steps in cone 10 reduction firing.
